notes.title: Shining Song Starnova: Idol Empire Now Live! - 20th Feb 2020
notes.content:
An all new business simulation set in the Shining Song Starnova universe!

The girls of Starnova are back in a new business simulation game! Due to the underhanded machinations of the evil Golden Calf Productions, the girls' live has been cancelled, and what's worse, their talent agency has had to relocate to a new office!

This time, it'll fall upon Producer-san to turn this dire predicament around! As the girls' manager, you'll have to build your office, re-hire the girls, and of course, get the money flowing back by putting on the greatest lives in the nation!

Do you have the management skills to once again accomplish everyone's dreams? Now, you must take the reins as Producer-san and save the day!

The original announcement can be [url=https://twitter.com/Love_In_Space/status/1223998627531689984]found here[/url].

notes.title: Steam s first sexually explicit Adult Only games are out now, but not in every region
notes.content:
With the release of Negligee: Love Stories last Friday, a major new door has been opened on Steam. Sexually explicit games are now allowed on the storefront, albeit filtered out by default. However, the Adult Only tag excludes games from sale from many countries for legal reasons, according to this Steam forum post by Negligee developers Dharker Studio.

Restrictions aside, there’s more good news for fans of extremely naked people in games. The first wave of official Adult Only content patches have begun to roll out for previously-cut games on Steam. Along the first is the pop idol-themed visual novel Shining Song Starnova (also available on GOG), although several more have surfaced since.

notes.title: Shining Song Starnova Goes Live on 25/07/2018... Sorta!
notes.content:
Following our [url=https://twitter.com/Love_In_Space/status/1017358776352104448]update on Twitter[/url] we've now decided to go ahead with releasing the game initially via other channels.

[b]These channels will be:[/b]

- GOG
- Denpasoft
- MangaGamer

[b]As of 25/07/2018:[/b]

- JAST USA
- Nutaku

We'll continue to work with Valve once more information is available and remain committed to do everything we can to get a version on Steam but until then the Steam release will remain without a release date.

notes.title: Backerkit Merchandise: Ending on 04/20
notes.content:
Following our recent announcement on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sekaiproject/shining-song-starnova-idol-anime-themed-visual-nov/posts/2154159]Kickstarter[/url] the Backerkit lockdown is fast approaching on the 20th April 2018.

Backerkit is a service that will allow you to pre order merchandise for Starnova such as dakimakuras, keychains, mousepads and much much more through a pledge. This pledge isn't collected straight away allowing for flexibility with deciding what you want to go with, then once the lockdown occurs your choice is fixed into an order and your payment method will be charged. You then can sit back and await your new goodies getting shipped out later in the year.

With the exception of digital items it is all 'while stocks last' and therefore once the Backerkit has closed it will be unlikely that anymore of these items will be made available. This is your last chance to take advantage!

Additionally the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sekaiproject/shining-song-starnova-idol-anime-themed-visual-nov/posts/2154159]Kickstarter announcement[/url] has a sample of the vocal songs that will be included in the game which we highly recommend checking out.

The Backerkit can be accessed [url=https://shining-song-starnova.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders/]here.[/url]

You can also follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Love_In_Space]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/loveinspacepr]Facebook[/url] for more information on progress and related content.

notes.title: Shining Song Starnova Kickstarter Now Live
notes.content:
As announced via social media we have now launched our Kickstarter page for Starnova giving you a chance to get your hands on exclusive merchandise and an early discount on your copy of the full game.

The Kickstarter page also features links to the first two episodes of the Starnova Net Show with hosts Yayoi Hayase (cv. Aki Kashiwagi), Mako Ayane (cv. Julie Watanabe), Mami Yahiro (cv. Mika Hashimoto) as they take part in character skits, game announcements, Let's Plays, Q&A, and more.

Why not check it out? The full page can be [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sekaiproject/shining-song-starnova-idol-anime-themed-visual-nov/description]found here[/url].

[b]September 2017:[/b] We're now successfully funded, thank you for helping us with the last leg of development.
